meta.name: glycoengineering
meta.description: Analyze and engineer protein glycosylation. Scan sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and access curated glycoengineering tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench). For glycoprotein engineering, therapeutic antibody optimization, and vaccine design.

copy.tagline: 分析蛋白糖基化位点，辅助抗体优化与疫苗设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正从事糖蛋白工程或治疗性抗体优化
copy.tagline_en: Analyze protein glycosylation sites to aid antibody optimization and vaccine design
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work on glycoprotein engineering or therapeutic antibody optimization

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能分析蛋白质序列中的N-糖基化位点（N-X-S/T）和预测O-糖基化热点，并提供糖基化工程工具（如NetOGlyc）的使用说明。可用于抗体、疫苗等设计。
howto.when: 当你提供蛋白质序列并要求分析糖基化位点、预测O-糖基化、修改糖基化（添加或消除），或询问糖基化工程工具时触发。

say.text: 分析这条蛋白质序列的N-糖基化位点。
say.note: Claude将扫描并列出所有N-X-S/T位点。

say.text: 预测该序列的O-糖基化热点。
say.note: Claude会基于局部Ser/Thr密度给出候选位置。

say.text: 帮我消除第297位的糖基化位点。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze protein sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and provide access to glycoengineering tools like NetOGlyc. Useful for antibody, vaccine, and therapeutic protein design.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a protein sequence and request glycosylation site analysis, O-glycosylation prediction, site modification (add/remove), or ask about glycoengineering tools.

say_en.text: Analyze this protein sequence for N-glycosylation sites.
say_en.note: Claude will scan and list all N-X-S/T sequons.

say_en.text: Predict O-glycosylation hotspots in this sequence.
say_en.note: Claude will give candidate positions based on S/T density.

say_en.text: Remove the glycosylation site at position 297.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a mutated sequence (N→Q).
